page_title: RSO 2-1 SEV | Real Sociedad v Sevilla 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Lucas Ocampos did his best and is replaced by Federico Gattoni (Sevilla).
90' The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.

90' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
90' Diego Alonso has decided to substitute Fernando and he is replaced by Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
88' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is sent off after saying something out of turn to the referee while confronting him!
88' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) has to leave the pitch!
86' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Sergio Ramos (Sevilla)! Let's see what he decides.
86' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) is sent off! He justly receives a yellow card and it is his second one, a red card must be given. The match ends for him.
84' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Hamari Traore will be replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
84' Here comes a substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Takefusa Kubo.
84' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Marko Dmitrovic.
82' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
82' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
81' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
81' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
79' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
78' The game is interrupted. Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
77' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul after Fernando (Sevilla) hacks down one of his opponents.

77' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Marko Dmitrovic makes a great save to stop the effort going low into the middle of the goal.
75' Here comes a substitution. Umar Sadiq is given a rest as he is replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mikel Merino as he is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
73' Diego Alonso prepares a substitution. Dodi Lukebakio is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla).
73' Substitution. Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) replaces Loic Bade.
71' The game is interrupted now, Loic Bade (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

71' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Marko Dmitrovic shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
69' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
68' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Alex Remiro comes off his line to intercept.
67' Substitution. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ander Barrenetxea walks off.
67' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
66' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
65' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro is well positioned and punches the ball away.
64' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Sevilla.
63' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
60' 2 - 1 Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
58' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
57' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Real Sociedad win a corner.
56' A cross, provided by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger.
56' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Sevilla are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
54' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
53' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
51' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
51' The linesman signals that Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
50' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
49' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
49' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
48' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
47' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Torres (Sevilla) replaces Boubakary Soumare.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
45+1' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Marko Dmitrovic is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
43' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
43' The ball is cleared after Jesus Navas (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
39' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

39' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Sevilla, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
38' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
36' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
34' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is quickest to intercept the ball.
33' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
32' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
30' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes a short corner kick.
29' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
27' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
25' Sevilla win a free kick.

22' 2 - 0 What a spectacular moment! Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) skips past defenders and finds some space before blasting a long-range strike at goal. The fans are amazed when they see the ball go into the top right corner. The scoreline is 2:0.

20' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
19' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
17' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Alex Remiro.
16' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias sees the trip by Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
15' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) picks up a long through ball, but Marko Dmitrovic deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
14' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

13' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Alex Remiro makes a smart save to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
11' Sevilla will take a free kick.
10' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
9' Real Sociedad control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a throw-in.
3' 1 - 0 Marko Dmitrovic (Sevilla) has scored a goal! Unfortunately for him and his teammates it's an own goal.

3' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is the one to supervise the game today.
